_source: Retired URLs and where they now lead. website/_src/build.py turns this list into `clwydian-academy 2/vercel.json` (permanent 301 redirects, with and without the trailing slash) and deletes any built page still sitting at a retired URL. To retire another page: remove it from website/_src/pages.json, delete its fragments, add one line here, rebuild. `to` must be a page that exists; the build fails if it is not.
